newsitem.title: UK: Greece, Portugal have EU diesel waiver - traders.
newsitem.headline: Greece, Portugal have EU diesel waiver - traders.

text.p: Portuguese and Greek refiners have received temporary deferrals to the October 1 EU deadline for the introduction of low sulphur diesel, Mediterranean oil traders said on Monday.
"They have waivers. (Portuguese state oil company) Petrogal has until March 1997 and Greece has until January 1997," said a trader for a major Italian refinery.

A European Commission official said on Monday that it had received no requests from EU governments for waivers to the deadline for the lowering of the sulphur content of diesel from 0.2 to 0.05 percent.
But just a day before the deadline, Petrogal was in the market looking for the higher sulphur diesel fuel, the Italian refiner said.
Greece is also unprepared for the changeover, as only two of its four refineries have completed the installation of desulphurisation units, an Athens-based oil trader said.
But he said Greece and other southern European countries had agreed a deferral with the EU earlier in the summer to give time to run down high 0.2 sulhur diesel stocks.
"All southern European countries have a deferral at their discretion for the first few months to run down 0.2 stocks," he said. "Greece isn't going over (to 0.05 percent) yet."

The 1993 EU directive provides for exceptions in the event of "a sudden change in the supply of crude oil or petroleum products" which makes it difficult for a country to apply the limit on gas oil sulphur content, a European Commission official said.
The directive says in that case the Commission "may authorise a higher limit to be applicable within the territory of that member state for a period not exceeding six months."
But this would not apply to the current situation in Greece and Portugal, the official said.
Officials from Petrogal and Greece's Public Petroleum Corp (PPC) said on Friday that they were seeking extensions of one year and three months respectively to the October 1 deadline.
